subject: Post-call: procurement route + payment method confirmation (PO vs card) — decision owners
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Park <jane.park@brightbridgehealth.com>, procurement@brightbridgehealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: procurement route + payment method confirmation (PO vs card) — decision owners

Hi Jane — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the procurement route and internal owners at BrightBridge:  

Summary from our discussion:
- Preferred deployment: Redwood Hosted API (team wants fast time-to-value; may evaluate Dedicated later)
- Volume profile: ~10M tokens/month initially; spikes end of quarter
- Security posture: SOC2 + perimeter controls acceptable; they will share a short list of compliance docs
- Commercial question to confirm: is purchase via PO/standard procurement or will you use a company card/credit? Also asked about marketplace procurement (AWS Marketplace) interest.

Action items / ask of BrightBridge:
1) Confirm procurement route: PO (standard terms) OR card (procurement prefers card for smaller pilots) OR AWS Marketplace. Please indicate preference and who signs.
2) Provide name/email of the legal/sourcing contact (if PO path) and the finance approver for budget signoff (economic buyer).
3) If PO path, confirm approximate lead time for issuing a PO and whether a PO number is required before technical onboarding.

What I need from our side:
- I attached a draft SOW (SOW_draft_v3.pdf) and a compact procurement checklist (BrightBridge_procurement_flow.xlsx) that summarizes typical Redwood steps for each payment path. If you prefer marketplace, we can provide the marketplace SOW variant.

Suggested next steps:
- You confirm procurement route + names this week
- If PO route: loop in procurement contact, target PO issuance within 2–3 weeks for pilot start in early December
- If card or marketplace: we can issue invoice + onboarding earlier (dependent on your billing ops)

Thanks — I’ll coordinate internally once you confirm so we can prep legal and finance for the correct workflow.

—
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0189

Looping Marissa in for procurement process guidance and to suggest our typical approval owners. Jane — if it helps, heres how we usually see BrightBridge-like orgs: 
- Economic buyer / budget owner: Head of Data / VP Engineering (owns budget)
- Finance sponsor: Procurement or Finance Ops (handles PO issuance, payment terms)
- Legal signatory: General Counsel or delegated signatory for contracts >$50k

If you end up on PO flow we can provide term sheets and a short checklist that maps who we need looped at each stage. Sharing SOW and the procurement flow workbook now.

—
Marissa Cole

Jane — quick nudge on names so we can prep the right paperwork. If you prefer, here are two short templates you can forward to your procurement/finance team to speed up the PO path:

1) Procurement intro (one-paragraph): 
Please see attached SOW and procurement checklist from Redwood Inference. The SOW outlines the pilot scope and billing cadence. Can you confirm whether a PO number is required prior to onboarding and typical PO lead time?

2) Finance approval note (two lines): 
Budget for pilot (approx $8–12k depending on scope) to be approved by Head of Data / VP Engineering (name to follow). Requesting confirmation of payment method (PO vs card) and who will sign.

If I dont hear back by end of day Wednesday Ill follow up directly with Miguel and procurement to queue the PO path. Thanks!

—
Logan
